title: A Guide for the R Package `rhythm.metrics`
text: Delta C Delta V rhythm metrics based Ramus, F., Nespor, M., & Mehler, J. (1999). Correlates linguistic rhythm speech signal. Cognition, 73(3), 265-292. Delta C: SD total C durationDelta V: SD total V duration
code: delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) #> # A tibble: 2 × 3 #>   cv_label  mean_delta sd_delta #>   <chr>          <dbl>    <dbl> #> 1 consonant     0.0884   0.0354 #> 2 vowel         0.198    0.127 plot_delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: A Guide for the R Package `rhythm.metrics`
text: Varco C Varco V rhythm metrics based Dellwo, Volker (2006). Rhythm Speech Rate: Variation Coefficient deltaC. : Karnowski, P; Szigeti, . Language language-processing. Frankfurt/Main: Peter Lang, 231-241. Varco C: Delta C / mean(C duration) * 100Varco V: Delta V / mean(V duration) * 100
code: varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   cv_label  varco_cv #>   <chr>        <dbl> #> 1 consonant     30.7 #> 2 vowel         31.9 plot_varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: A Guide for the R Package `rhythm.metrics`
text: %V rhythm metrics based Ramus, F., Nespor, M., & Mehler, J. (1999). Correlates linguistic rhythm speech signal. Cognition, 73(3), 265-292. calculates percentage utterance occupied vocalic material. %V: (total V duration / total utterance duration) * 100
code: percentage_v(df, v_label = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration) #> # A tibble: 1 × 3 #>   cv_label mean_percent_v sd_percent_v #>   <chr>             <dbl>        <dbl> #> 1 vowel              57.3         20.4 plot_percentage_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel",                    utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration)

title: A Guide for the R Package `rhythm.metrics`
text: rPVI C rhythm metrics based Grabe, E., & Low, E. L. (2002). Durational variability speech rhythm class hypothesis. Laboratory phonology 7 (pp. 515-546). De Gruyter Mouton. calculates sum absolute differences pairs consecutive consonantal intervals divided number pairs speech sample.
code: rpvi_c(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration) #> # A tibble: 1 × 1 #>    rpvi #>   <dbl> #> 1 0.125 plot_rpvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: A Guide for the R Package `rhythm.metrics`
text: nPVI V rhythm metrics based Grabe, E., & Low, E. L. (2002). Durational variability speech rhythm class hypothesis. Laboratory phonology 7 (pp. 515-546). De Gruyter Mouton. calculates normalised sum absolute differences pairs consecutive vocalic intervals divided number pairs speech sample.
code: npvi_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration) #> # A tibble: 1 × 1 #>    npvi #>   <dbl> #> 1  45.1 plot_npvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: rhythm.metrics: Analyse Visualise Speech Rhythm Timing Metrics package calculates visualises speech rhythm timing metrics consonantal vocalic interval durations. provides standardised workflow compute common metrics including Delta C, Delta V, Varco C, Varco V, %V, rPVI-C, nPVI-V, well plotting functions exploring presenting results. Note: rhythm.metrics slow active development, additional metrics may added future releases.

title: rhythm.metrics
text: Calculate common rhythm metrics interval-duration data Summarise rhythm metrics across utterances Visualise rhythm metrics ready--use plotting functions Work directly simple data frames

title: rhythm.metrics
text: package expects data frame containing interval labels, utterance identifiers, interval durations. typical input data frame looks like :
code: df <- data.frame(   cv_label = c(     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel"   ),   utterance_id = c(     "utt_1", "utt_1", "utt_1", "utt_1",     "utt_2", "utt_2", "utt_2", "utt_2",     "utt_3", "utt_3", "utt_3", "utt_3",     "utt_4", "utt_4", "utt_4", "utt_4"   ),   cv_duration = c(     0.10, 0.80, 0.20, 0.50,     0.30, 0.30, 0.40, 0.70,     0.30, 0.88, 0.50, 0.90,     0.30, 0.57, 0.40, 0.97   ),   utterance_duration = c(     2.4, 2.4, 2.4, 2.4,     2.7, 2.7, 2.7, 2.7,     3.4, 3.4, 3.4, 3.4,     1.8, 1.8, 1.8, 1.8   ) )

title: rhythm.metrics
text: Delta C Delta V rhythm metrics based : Ramus, F., Nespor, M., & Mehler, J. (1999). Correlates linguistic rhythm speech signal. Cognition, 73(3), 265-292. Delta C: standard deviation consonantal interval durations Delta V: standard deviation vocalic interval durations
code: delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: Varco C Varco V based : Dellwo, V. (2006). Rhythm Speech Rate: Variation Coefficient deltaC. P. Karnowski & . Szigeti (Eds.), Language language-processing (pp. 231-241). Peter Lang. Varco C: Delta C / mean consonant duration * 100 Varco V: Delta V / mean vowel duration * 100
code: varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: %V based : Ramus, F., Nespor, M., & Mehler, J. (1999). Correlates linguistic rhythm speech signal. Cognition, 73(3), 265-292. measures percentage total utterance duration occupied vocalic material.
code: percentage_v(df, v_label = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration) plot_percentage_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel",                    utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: rPVI-C based : Grabe, E., & Low, E. L. (2002). Durational variability speech rhythm class hypothesis. Laboratory Phonology 7 (pp. 515-546). De Gruyter Mouton. calculates average absolute difference consecutive consonantal intervals.
code: rpvi_c(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_rpvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: nPVI-V based : Grabe, E., & Low, E. L. (2002). Durational variability speech rhythm class hypothesis. Laboratory Phonology 7 (pp. 515-546). De Gruyter Mouton. calculates normalised average absolute difference consecutive vocalic intervals.
code: npvi_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_npvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration)

title: rhythm.metrics
text: simple workflow package might look like :
code: library(rhythm.metrics)  df <- data.frame(   cv_label = c(     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel",     "consonant", "vowel", "consonant", "vowel"   ),   utterance_id = c(     "utt_1", "utt_1", "utt_1", "utt_1",     "utt_2", "utt_2", "utt_2", "utt_2",     "utt_3", "utt_3", "utt_3", "utt_3",     "utt_4", "utt_4", "utt_4", "utt_4"   ),   cv_duration = c(     0.10, 0.80, 0.20, 0.50,     0.30, 0.30, 0.40, 0.70,     0.30, 0.88, 0.50, 0.90,     0.30, 0.57, 0.40, 0.97   ),   utterance_duration = c(     2.4, 2.4, 2.4, 2.4,     2.7, 2.7, 2.7, 2.7,     3.4, 3.4, 3.4, 3.4,     1.8, 1.8, 1.8, 1.8   ) )  # Analysis delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) percentage_v(df, v_label = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration) rpvi_c(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration) npvi_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration)  # Visualisation plot_delta_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_varco_cv(df, cv_label, utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_percentage_v(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel",                    utterance_id, cv_duration, utterance_duration) plot_rpvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "consonant", utterance_id, cv_duration) plot_npvi(df, cv_label, label_name = "vowel", utterance_id, cv_duration)
